terms.inspectedEntity: Read-only entity shown by Inspect in the contextual inspector.
terms.networkSelection: Plan membership in the Network cluster.
terms.activeTransmitter: Existing single-mode active cell / primary current transmitter.
terms.mapFocus: Existing visualization emphasis and ray-scope reference.
terms.selectedSolution: Optimization/Results state, unaffected by map inspection.

invariants: Inspecting a Cell does not add/remove it from the Network cluster, activate it, dirty the plan, stale the result, change the Scenario fingerprint, or change Map Focus.
Map Focus changes only the existing visualization context/viewport behavior; it does not mutate cluster membership, active transmitter, result freshness, or Scenario identity.
Changing Map Focus does not automatically open the inspector.
Inspecting a Cell reports Map Focus as Focused or Not focused; a no-op Focus action is omitted from the inspector when already focused.
The View menu omits Inspect focused cell when the focused Cell is already the inspected Cell.

entryPoints: Click a map entity while Inspect is active
Conditional Inspect focused cell action in View
explicitInspection.result: Read-only inspector remains authoritative for identity, source, active transmitter, cluster membership, Map Focus, RF profile, details, and existing owning-tool actions.

popupDecision.Cell: Remove detailed click-open Leaflet popup; inspector and marker styling own Cell identity and state.
popupDecision.coverageGap: Remove duplicated click-open detail popup; use the existing inspector.
popupDecision.recommendation: Remove duplicated click-open detail popup; use the existing inspector.
popupDecision.communicationPath: Remove repeated route/status details from click-open popup; retain its compact map-anchored interface-family tooltip (Xn-C / Xn-U or fallback N2 via AMF).
popupDecision.buildingAndSamples: Use inspector where a map entity is inspectable; no parallel detailed popup was added.
popupDecision.hover: No inspector facts were moved into a persistent hover card; the path tooltip retains only its spatially useful interface label.

networkEvidence.inspectorE2E: Cell inspector opens with no .leaflet-popup, preserves RF context/run-state text, and produces zero analyze/simulate/optimize/interference requests during inspect, Focus, and Inventory navigation.
networkEvidence.selectionE2E: Select cells updates Network membership without opening inspector and produces zero compute requests until an explicit compute action.
